title: END v2.1 prospective exclusive outcome view (not implemented)
description: Valid instance means structural constraints AND ALL x-semantic-rules with external evidence hold. Schema shape alone confers no source authenticity, provenance certificate or answer correctness. Typed errors are not serialized members.

x-semantic-rules.normative_rule: Strict JSON: reject duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity and finite-overflow numeric tokens before schema validation. Boolean is not integer.

Source eligibility is external evidence, never established by serialized booleans: normal/restricted require existing F01 completed verifier PASS on referenced bytes/identity/closure at the SAME guarded capture_id. Recompute source provenance/reason and hashes; caller-provided statuses do not substitute.

A/S requires audited cooperative writer domain and common membership/content cut under all guards described in R1_SNAPSHOT_ACQUISITION. File hashes/timestamps or before/after equality alone never establish it. Strong graph claims require exact R1 witness inventory and closed ID coverage; missing/extra/conflicting mandatory witnesses downgrade to S.

Every justified claim from the captured evidence must be emitted with its scoped source refs. Unsupported facts must not be invented. claim.snapshot_id == accounting.snapshot.capture_id; claim.scope.run_id == run_binding.run_id; refs/digests must resolve to retained capture bytes and trusted local capture provenance.

ANCHORED_GRAPH_CARDINALITY requires tier A and GUARDED_VISIBLE_GRAPH, coverage ANCHORED_GRAPH_IN_CUT, identical sorted distinct IDs in value/scope/verified witness graph, and cardinality == len(IDs). Zero requires positively verified empty closed set, not merely absent ledger rows. Other tiers cannot emit this kind.

CORROBORATED_RESERVATION_DISPATCH requires matching immutable-at-capture reservation/dispatch run/attempt/task/stage/intent identities from execution-origin channels. Its two source hash refs must exist. CORROBORATED_IDENTITY_GROUP requires at least two distinct independently captured named channels with actual cross-binding/origin checks, not two copies/paths of one source. One recorded identity is not actual provider inference or full-run count.

USAGE_METADATA CORROBORATED_WITHIN_SCOPE requires checked per-field types and arithmetic when all known plus witness bindings at that stated tier; raw receipt status is separately established. Contradictory recorded metadata may be retained only OBSERVED/INCONSISTENT with limitations, never complete cost.

COMPLETE totals require tier A, current provenance VERIFIED, closure/no future generation, complete covered reservation/settlement/usage/required raw-response validation, no unknown/outstanding/conflicting costs, and totals equal that exact set. total_tokens == input_tokens + output_tokens. Every other case has null complete_totals with explicit reason; unknown is never zero/refund.

Candidate IDs unique and every observed candidate/attempt is grounded in captured source identities. PRESENT content_sha256 == SHA256(UTF8(content)) AND matches retained source bytes/identity, not merely a rehashed substitute. SOURCE_VERIFIED_BINDING and handle labels must match the trusted source proof for that candidate. Missing content never invented. VERIFIED parent IDs refer to earlier captured candidate IDs and valid ancestry. initial_ref if non-null references original bound initial candidate, never guessed from array index.

candidate_selected true iff selected_candidate_ref is non-null and references exactly one PRESENT eligible candidate with SOURCE_VERIFIED_BINDING, ELIGIBLE response, VERIFIED lineage and SOURCE_VERIFIED handle. Bound handle/run/task/call/attempt/wire/provenance/settlement/order proof must match current source artifact; rebound/missing/unavailable selection fails. This certifies binding/selection only, never answer truth.

Diagnostics never select. Raw observed/missing candidates may remain with correct authority. NONE_SUPPORTABLE/UNAVAILABLE entries=[] does not mean zero generated candidates; KNOWN_EMPTY_HISTORY requires positively verified complete empty history. An interrupted terminal may retain an independently supported valid C0; invalid later content does not automatically erase an earlier eligible C0.

source_publication.path basename == file_name; SHA matches unchanged verified source bytes. Diagnostic file paths never use RESULT.json/COMMON_RESULT.json and are never normal prepared certificates. Prior artifact observation never grants current verification or selection. artifact_persisted describes referenced source artifact, NOT persistence of envelope wire bytes.

Deterministic partition: grounded diagnostic cause => diagnostic (BLOCKED only for INTEGRITY_HOLD; UNKNOWN for snapshot/unsupported observation). Else current verified source + provenance VERIFIED + normal reason => NORMAL; current verified source + (VERIFIED/restricted reason OR INTERRUPTED|UNKNOWN/uncertain reason) => RESTRICTED. Other inputs raise typed/operational error, no serialized member. Typed integrity rejection is outside the union and matches zero variants.

Opt-in version routing only. Version-aware legacy normal readers reject any schema_version/variant envelope; validate archived legacy data only with its existing full verifier. Current diagnostic schema is a diagnostic, never RunResult. Unknown/missing/mixed version/class flags reject; arbitrary noncompliant shape-only readers have no compatibility guarantee. No embedded legacy result/C0/FINAL payload is permitted.
